{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}You are {c_important}Blood Lanced{/c}, and when {c_important}Blood Lance{/c} would deal damage to you, it instead {c_important}{u}Fortifies{/u}{/c} you for {c_number}[Affix_Value_2|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life and has a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c} chance to form a {c_important}Blood Orb{/c}.

{c_important}Blood Lance{/c} deals {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1 * Affix."Static Value 0"|%x|]{/c} increased damage.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
